description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Coinbase is looking for an experienced SEC Reporting Manager to join our Financial Reporting organization. Reporting to the Director, SEC Reporting, this role will serve as a key owner of Coinbase’s external reporting process, including Forms 10-Q, 10-K, 8-K, earnings release support, and related audit and control activities. This role will coordinate with Controllership, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, Tax, and external auditors, while also helping drive improvements to our reporting infrastructure, Workiva processes, and disclosure operating model in a fast-moving public-company environment.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own major portions of the end-to-end 10-Q / 10-K / 8-K production cycle, including calendar management, drafting coordination, review workflows, tie-outs, and final filing support.
  • Lead complex disclosure areas, translating accounting, business, and operational changes into clear and decision-useful external reporting.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Controllership, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, Tax, and external auditors to resolve judgmental issues and deliver timely, accurate filings.
  • Drive structural improvements to SEC reporting, including Workiva, source-data flows, supporting templates, review controls, and process documentation.
  • Support audit requests, quarterly board / audit committee materials, and other ad hoc analyses tied to external reporting.
  • Coach and elevate junior team members through review, process discipline, and operating best practices.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 9+ years of relevant experience in SEC reporting, external reporting, or public-company financial reporting, including recent hands-on ownership of 10-Q / 10-K processes.
  • CPA or equivalent required.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, SEC disclosure requirements, SOX controls, and public-company reporting mechanics.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex disclosures, coordinating auditors, and managing cross-functional stakeholders under tight deadlines.
  • Experience with Workiva (Wdesk), NetSuite, and spreadsheet-based analytical review in a controlled reporting environment.
  • Strong written judgment, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to improve ambiguous or evolving processes.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 

 

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):
$166,345—$195,700 USD
